## Summary

<!-- One sentence: what does this PR change, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation / vignettes only
- [ ] Internal refactor / build / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] I have run `devtools::document()` and the regenerated Rd / NAMESPACE files are included.
- [ ] I have run `devtools::test()` and all tests pass locally.
- [ ] I have run `lintr::lint_package()` and the package is lint-clean (or new `# nolint` markers are justified inline).
- [ ] I have updated `NEWS.md` for any user-visible change.
- [ ] If this changes a public API: I have updated examples, vignettes, and added regression tests.
